pkgmetadata.longdescription: Youta-bin installs Youta's official prebuilt Linux release for amd64 or arm64. The binary includes upstream's fixed default provider set, terminal UI, mpv playback backend, yt-dlp integration, tracker-module support, and the human-readable state backend. Terminal image rendering is selected with the images USE flag; SQLite is not included. Install media-sound/youta instead when granular build-time feature selection or a non-glibc target is required.

use.flag: Install the release binary with terminal artwork support.
Request PipeWire audio-output support from media-video/mpv.
